review_basis: Full reports were cross-checked for internal consistency against the project rubric, local ISO reference summaries, and source-evidence traceability. Instructor or qualified-auditor approval remains external to this repository.
annotation_note: Project-authored synthetic development Gold AuditReports. Do not describe these labels as instructor-approved until the instructor review checklist is signed.

rubric.major_nc: Evidence demonstrates absence or systemic failure of a required management-system process.
rubric.minor_nc: Evidence demonstrates a specific requirement failure without sufficient support for a systemic failure.
rubric.observation: Evidence identifies a concern but is insufficient to establish a specific nonconformity.
rubric.ofi: Evidence supports a practical improvement without demonstrating a requirement failure.

cases.reference_finding: The defined ISMS scope was not available as documented information.
cases.rationale: The boundaries are understood, but the required documented scope was unavailable. The evidence establishes a specific documentation failure without showing wider systemic absence.

report.executive_summary: The audit identified a specific documented-information gap concerning the defined ISMS scope.

findings.finding_statement: The defined ISMS scope was not available as documented information.
objective_evidence: Auditee: ISMS Manager. Position: Security Manager. Interview Notes: scope boundaries understood by mgmt incl HQ + cloud ops; discussed last review. could not show documented ISMS scope. Interfaces/dependencies known verbally only.
findings.suggested_corrective_action: Document, approve, and maintain the ISMS scope, including its boundaries, interfaces, and dependencies.

report.disclaimer: Draft report for auditor review and sign-off only.

cases.reference_finding: The information security policy is approaching review, but the sampled evidence did not establish missing required content or failed communication.
cases.rationale: A policy exists and is available. An upcoming review does not by itself demonstrate nonconformity.

report.executive_summary: The audit recorded an observation requiring follow-up on the information security policy review.

findings.finding_statement: The information security policy is approaching review, but the sampled evidence did not establish missing required content or failed communication.
objective_evidence: Checklist Item: information security policy — current / communicated / reviewed? Result: PARTIAL INFO. Notes: approved policy exists on intranet. review date coming up. sample does not show missing required content and no evidence staff failed to receive it. verify next audit.
findings.suggested_corrective_action: Complete the scheduled policy review and retain evidence of approval and communication.

open_questions: Confirm the completed review date and sample evidence of policy communication.
report.disclaimer: Draft report for auditor review and sign-off only.

cases.reference_finding: The available role list was incomplete, while assignment and communication of all required information security responsibilities remained unverified.
cases.rationale: The sample does not establish that required roles are unassigned; additional job-description evidence is needed.

report.executive_summary: The audit recorded an observation about incomplete evidence of information security role assignments.

findings.finding_statement: The available role list was incomplete, while assignment and communication of all required information security responsibilities remained unverified.
objective_evidence: Auditee: HR lead. Position: Human Resources. Interview Notes: security roles list only has CISO + IT admin. HR says other responsibilities may be in job descriptions but sample not collected today. Cannot confirm whether every required role is assigned and communicated.
findings.suggested_corrective_action: Compile and verify the complete set of information security roles, responsibilities, authorities, and communication records.

open_questions: Do current job descriptions assign and communicate every required information security responsibility?
report.disclaimer: Draft report for auditor review and sign-off only.

cases.reference_finding: An information security risk assessment process had not been established or applied across the ISMS scope.
cases.rationale: The evidence explicitly shows absence of the required management-system process, methodology, criteria, ownership, and completed assessment.

report.executive_summary: The audit identified a major nonconformity because the required information security risk assessment process was absent.

findings.finding_statement: An information security risk assessment process had not been established or applied across the ISMS scope.
objective_evidence: Checklist Item: information security risk assessment process established + applied? Result: NON-COMPLIANT. Notes: no approved methodology, no assessment criteria, no risk owners and no completed ISMS risk assessment anywhere in scope. Management confirmed process has not been established.
findings.suggested_corrective_action: Establish, approve, document, and apply a repeatable information security risk assessment process across the ISMS scope.

report.disclaimer: Draft report for auditor review and sign-off only.

cases.reference_finding: An information security risk treatment process had not been established for the ISMS scope.
cases.rationale: The evidence shows organization-wide absence of risk treatment, control selection, the Statement of Applicability, and risk-owner acceptance.

report.executive_summary: The audit identified a major nonconformity because the information security risk treatment process was absent.

findings.finding_statement: An information security risk treatment process had not been established for the ISMS scope.
objective_evidence: Document Name: Risk Treatment Pack. Reference: RTP-index / empty. Review Notes: requested risk treatment process, treatment plan, control selection and SoA. none available. no risk-owner acceptance of residual risk. management confirmed risk treatment process not established for any ISMS area.
findings.suggested_corrective_action: Establish and apply the risk treatment process, treatment plan, control selection, Statement of Applicability, and required risk-owner approvals.

report.disclaimer: Draft report for auditor review and sign-off only.

cases.reference_finding: Information security objectives and the arrangements required to achieve and monitor them had not been established.
cases.rationale: The absence applies across functions and levels and persisted after a prior internal note, supporting a systemic planning failure.

report.executive_summary: The audit identified a major nonconformity concerning absent information security objectives and planning arrangements.

findings.finding_statement: Information security objectives and the arrangements required to achieve and monitor them had not been established.
objective_evidence: Document Name: ISMS Objectives Register. Reference: OBJ-REG. Review Notes: blank template only. no information security objectives at any function/level, no target, owner, measure, resource, due date or monitoring record. prior internal note raised same absence; still not implemented.
findings.suggested_corrective_action: Establish documented information security objectives with owners, measures, resources, due dates, and monitoring arrangements.

report.disclaimer: Draft report for auditor review and sign-off only.

cases.reference_finding: Post-hire competence evidence and effectiveness checks were not sampled, so continuing competence remained unverified.
cases.rationale: Recruitment checks and coaching exist, and the evidence does not establish that personnel are incompetent or that required records are absent.

report.executive_summary: The audit recorded an observation requiring additional sampling of competence evidence.

findings.finding_statement: Post-hire competence evidence and effectiveness checks were not sampled, so continuing competence remained unverified.
objective_evidence: Auditee: HR officer. Position: Recruitment. Interview Notes: competence checked when hiring; manager coaching happens. auditor did not sample qualification/training records after hire and did not establish any employee was incompetent. follow-up needed on retained evidence and effectiveness checks.
findings.suggested_corrective_action: Sample retained competence records and verify how the effectiveness of competence-building actions is evaluated.

open_questions: What competence records and effectiveness evaluations are retained after recruitment?
report.disclaimer: Draft report for auditor review and sign-off only.

cases.reference_finding: Formal annual awareness training was absent, while personnel awareness of required ISMS topics remained unverified.
cases.rationale: Alternative awareness activities exist. Absence of one preferred course format does not prove lack of awareness.

report.executive_summary: The audit recorded an observation requiring verification of personnel security awareness.

findings.finding_statement: Formal annual awareness training was absent, while personnel awareness of required ISMS topics remained unverified.
objective_evidence: Checklist Item: security awareness. Result: NEEDS VERIFICATION. Notes: no formal annual course, but monthly security emails and onboarding briefing samples exist. audit did not test whether staff understand policy, contribution to ISMS, or consequences of nonconformity.
findings.suggested_corrective_action: Evaluate whether current awareness activities produce the required understanding and retain evidence of the evaluation.

open_questions: Do sampled personnel understand the policy, their contribution, and consequences of nonconformity?
report.disclaimer: Draft report for auditor review and sign-off only.

cases.reference_finding: Document retrieval could be improved by consolidating the controlled index and storage location.
cases.rationale: Required sampled documents were available, current, and controlled; the evidence supports efficiency improvement rather than a requirement failure.

report.executive_summary: The audit identified an opportunity to improve the efficiency of controlled-document retrieval.

findings.finding_statement: Document retrieval could be improved by consolidating the controlled index and storage location.
objective_evidence: Document Name: ISMS document index. Reference: DOC-IDX-04. Review Notes: required documents sampled were available and current, access controlled. retrieval took 8–12 min across folders. team plans one indexed location; improvement only, no unavailable document identified.
findings.suggested_corrective_action: Consolidate the controlled document index and define a consistent retrieval location while preserving access controls.

report.disclaimer: Draft report for auditor review and sign-off only.

cases.reference_finding: The ISMS audit programme and schedule were still being prepared, while the available evidence did not establish that required audits had been missed.
cases.rationale: The programme's adequacy requires verification, but the evidence does not prove absence or failure of required internal audits.

report.executive_summary: The audit recorded an observation requiring verification of the ISMS internal audit programme.

findings.finding_statement: The ISMS audit programme and schedule were still being prepared, while the available evidence did not establish that required audits had been missed.
objective_evidence: Auditee: Quality audit lead. Position: Lead internal auditor. Interview Notes: team runs ISO 9001 audits; ISMS audit programme/schedule still being prepared and extra auditor training planned. evidence today does not establish required ISO 27001 audits were missed or programme is absent. confirm scope, frequency and records.
findings.suggested_corrective_action: Complete and approve the risk-based ISMS audit programme, including scope, frequency, methods, responsibilities, and retained records.

open_questions: Were any required ISMS audits missed, and what programme records are available?
report.disclaimer: Draft report for auditor review and sign-off only.
